function: Channel estimation in the delay-Doppler domain of an OTFS underwater acoustic link: IPNLMS coarse estimates denoised by FastDVDNet (p. 1, p. 3).
system: Uncoded OTFS, M=128, N=32, 10 kHz bandwidth around fc=15 kHz, underwater acoustic channel; antenna count not stated (scalar model); no RIS (p. 4).
method: Two-stage FastDVDNet (U-Net denoisers D1, D2) on five IPNLMS estimates treated as image frames; supervised training with MSE loss, Adam, batch 64, SNR-randomized noise (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Simulated UWA channels from the statistical model of Qarabaqi and Stojanovic [15]: 8000 channels, 100 m depth, 1-4 km range; split between training and testing not stated (p. 4).
test_conditions: Training noise level random over the SNR range (p. 3); testing at SNR 0-16 dB and pilot sizes 48x16, 56x16, 64x16; retraining per size not stated (p. 5).
baselines: Non-learned: OMP, IPNLMS alone, perfect CSI as bound; learned: IPNLMS+DnCNN single-image denoising [9] (p. 4-5, Fig. 5).
metrics: NMSE and BER versus SNR (Fig. 5); BER versus pilot size (Fig. 6) (p. 5).
complexity: Order of complexity given only for IPNLMS, O((Mτ−L)(Nν−2K)), versus OMP with extra factor P; denoiser cost only qualitative: 'not very high' (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "Statistical model proposed in [15] are used to generate complex UWA channels"; a published statistical UWA simulator, not 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "we also simulate the performance with less pilots"; the letter never says the network trained at one pilot size was tested at others, or on another scenario or band; p. 3: "σ is a random variable within the range of possible SNR" is an SNR sweep only.
q3_support: p. 4: "we select the DnCNN algorithm [9] as our comparison method" (learned) and "orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) is selected as the comparison algorithm" (non-learned); both compared on NMSE and BER in Fig. 5 (p. 5).
q4_support: p. 5: "the complexity during the inference phase is not very high due to the relatively small size of the network"; qualitative. The order O((Mτ − L)(Nν − 2K)) is stated only for the IPNLMS stage, with no FLOPs, parameters, or runtime for FastDVDNet.
q5_support: p. 4: "8000 UWA channels are generated in the simulation"; simulated channels, and no link or DOI for code or data appears anywhere in the letter (p. 1-5), no public dataset.
notes: Included as area 4 (delay-Doppler channel estimation for OTFS); the medium is underwater acoustic, not RF, flagged for the reviewer. q1 is 0 because ref. [15] is a published statistical UWA simulation model, not a standard or measured data. q2 is borderline: the pilot-size sweep of Fig. 6 (48x16 to 64x16, with 64x16 the base case) could be a test with fewer pilots than in training, but the letter does not say whether the network was retrained. q4 is borderline: an order of complexity is given for the IPNLMS stage (the non-learned part) but none for the learned denoiser. Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 legends read from the image of p. 5. Title and DOI on p. 1 match the work.
